questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Breakdown operation assumed। resistor drop Vin−Vz=nV। no load-এ সব current zener-এ=(13) mA।

questions.question_bn: Same pendulum planet A period 8s,planet Bperiod 4s। gB/gA কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। T∝1/√g sameL。 gB/gA=(TA/TB)²=2²=4; period ratio inverted and squared।

questions.question_bn: Particle charge 6 C uniform static B-এ moves, electric field নেই। magnetic force-এর কাজ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Magnetic force qv×B always perpendicular to velocity। P=F·v=0; speed/kinetic energy অপরিবর্তিত।

questions.question_bn: Water index 4/3। bottom apparent depth 36m near normal viewing। real depth কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Near-normal apparent depth=real depth/μ। real=μ·apparent=(4/3)·3×(12)=4×(12)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Vertical circle radius 7 m-এ rope just taut at top। g=10। minimum top speed² কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। At threshold top tension=0। gravity alone provides mv²/r: mg=mv²/(7)⇒v²=10×(7)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Two circular planets same orbital radius but central star mass M ও 4M। period ratio second/first কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Newton–Kepler T=2π√(r³/(GM))। same r-এ T∝M⁻½, তাই ratio 1/√(4)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Atomic electrons excited to level 7। সকল downward transitions possible। maximum distinct line count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Any pair of levels gives one transition in simple nondegenerate model। total pairs C((7),2)=(7)×((7)−1)/2।

questions.question_bn: Equal masses 5 kg, one at speed 4 m/s অন্য rest। stick together। lost kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Momentum gives final speed 2। initial K=8×(5), final K=½·2×(5)·4=4×(5)। loss=4×(5) J।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Unknown fork-এর সঙ্গে 200 Hz fork-এ 3 beats/s। unknown fork-এ wax দিলে beats কমে। original frequency কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Wax mass বাড়িয়ে unknown frequency কমায়। beats কমেছে মানে unknown প্রথমে 200-এর উপরে ছিল: 200+(3)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: SeriesAC R3Ω,XL5Ω,XC1Ω,supply Vrms 45VV। average power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Z=√(3²+(5−1)²)=5Ω। Irms=5×(9)/5=nA। activeP=I²R=3×(9)²W,apparentVI 5×(9)²separate।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=25×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((25)×10⁻²)=(1/(25))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 160g,dry mass 128g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(16)/(10×(16))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 12mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 22mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।

questions.question_bn: প্রতি molecule-এ 5 টি independent C≡C, অন্য unsaturation নেই।1 mol sample fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। প্রতি triple bond-এ twoπbonds; alkane পর্যন্ত saturation-এর জন্য 2H₂। মোট 2×(5) mol, semihydrogenation-এ(5)।

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 528g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Molar mass 132g/mol,samplenmol। each 2N⇒Nmass 2·14×(4)=28ng; fertilizer Npercentage 28/132×100।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 2100g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(21) g; remaining water 90×(21) g।

questions.question_bn: Acid ও alcohol 1:1 ester if i cation, limiting acid 9 mol, isolated yield 75%। ester mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Theoretical ester amount limiting acid (9) mol। actual 75%=0.75×(9)=3×(9)/4; excess alcohol yield multiplier নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water[Ca²⁺]=26mmol/L, no Mg। CaCO₃ equivalent hardness কত mg/L? MCaCO₃100g/mol
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Ca²⁺-এর 1mmol equivalent 1mmol CaCO₃।100g/mol⇒100mg/mmol; hardness 100nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ureasample 900g। nitrogen mass কত g? CO(NH₂)₂,MW60
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Eachureamolecule 2nitrogen atoms⇒28g Nper 60gurea। sample 60nghas 28ngN; mass fraction not atom fraction।

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=5/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(5)/10−(−0.2)=((5)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻18M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(18)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=15P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (15) gives concentration factor (15); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: At25°C,[OH⁻]=17×10⁻³M strong base। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। pOH=3−logn, pH=14−pOH=11+logn। water temperature 25°C থেকে p Kw14 ব্যবহার।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: সাধারণ gas-এর water solubility fixed pressure-এ temperature বাড়ালে সাধারণত কী হয়?
questions.explanation: Many gas dissolution exothermic; warming dissolved gas escape favour করে। gases/conditions-specific exceptions থাকলেও ordinary trend decrease।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ore290g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(29)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=14D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 16 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Balanced reaction 1Fe₂O₃gives 3CO₂। stoichiometric mole factor 3; iron yield 2nalternateseparateproduct।

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 36 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 18 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Initial H⁺0.2×(18) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(18) mmol; excess 0.1×(18) mmol,total 3×(18) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl precipitate dilute NH₃-এ dissolve হওয়ার প্রধান কারণ কী?
questions.explanation: NH₃ Ag⁺-কে stable soluble complex-এ ধরে, free Ag⁺ কমায়। dissolution equilibrium ডানে shift করে, ligand concentration গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

questions.explanation: Sulfur dioxide ও nitrogen oxides atmospheric oxidation/water chemistry-তে sulfuric/nitric acids তৈরি করে acid deposition বাড়ায়।

questions.question_bn: Same charge passes Ag⁺ ও Cu²⁺ cellsseries। depositedmoles Ag=3। Cumoles কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Agneeds 1electron,Cu2। equalcharge equalmoleelectrons⇒Cumoles half Agmoles=(3)/2।

questions.question_bn: H₂SO₄0.10M,50 mL পুরো neutralise করতে NaOH 0.20M কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Acidmoles 0.1·10nmmol=nmmol,base 2nmmol লাগে। V=2×(5)/0.2=10nmL; acid capacity 2explicit।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=19, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 30×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (30)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((30)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=19M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(19)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((19)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 4 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Alcohol carbon oxidation state increases 4units toacid। half-reaction 4electron per alcohol; aldehyde পর্যন্ত 2electron।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 8molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(8)/0.5=2×(8)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 76mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 19mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। HClconsumed=4×(19)−(19)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 15mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Mass ppm=mg solute/kg sample। (15) mg/2 kg=(15)/2 ppm; total food mass denominator।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Neutral closed-shell formula C18H35N। IHD কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Nitrogen formula IHD=(2C+2+N−H)/2। [2((16)+2)+2+1−(2×(16)+3)]/2=2। halogens থাকলে H equivalent কমাতে হয়।
